query:
query getPlaceListPopupstore($input: PlaceListInput, $isNmap: Boolean = false, $isBounds: Boolean = false, $reverseGeocodingInput: ReverseGeocodingInput, $useReverseGeocode: Boolean = false, $includeFilters: Boolean = true) {
  placeList(input: $input) {
    businesses {
      total
      items {
        ...CommonBusinessItems
        imageUrls
        visitorReviewCount
        blogCafeReviewCount
        hasVr
        coupon {
          ...CouponItems
          __typename
        }
        popupstoreInfo {
          operationStartDateTime
          operationEndDateTime
          remainingDays
          status {
            name
            value
            i18nKey
            __typename
          }
          admissionCondition {
            name
            i18nKey
            __typename
          }
          mediaList {
            type
            thumbnailUrl
            profileDisplayName
            profileThumbnailUrl
            source
            __typename
          }
          relatedPlaceName
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      nlu {
        queryResult {
          q
          region
          spot
          cid
          month
          unknown
          location {
            x
            y
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      queryString
      nluForInput
      optionsForMap @include(if: $isBounds) {
        ...OptionsForMap
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    filtersInfo @include(if: $includeFilters) {
      ...FiltersInfo
      __typename
    }
    houseBanners {
      ...HouseBanners
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  reverseGeocodingAddr(input: $reverseGeocodingInput) @include(if: $useReverseGeocode) {
    ...ReverseGeocodingAddr
    __typename
  }
}

fragment CommonBusinessItems on BusinessSummary {
  id
  dbType
  name
  businessCategory
  category
  hasBooking
  hasNPay
  x
  y
  distance
  imageUrl
  imageCount
  phone
  virtualPhone
  streetPanorama {
    id
    pan
    tilt
    lat
    lon
    fov
    __typename
  }
  roadAddress
  address
  commonAddress
  blogCafeReviewCount
  bookingReviewCount
  bookingBusinessId
  talktalkUrl
  detailCid {
    c0
    c1
    c2
    c3
    __typename
  }
  options
  promotionTitle
  newOpening
  hasWheelchairEntrance
  markerId @include(if: $isNmap)
  markerLabel @include(if: $isNmap) {
    text
    style
    __typename
  }
  imageMarker @include(if: $isNmap) {
    marker
    markerSelected
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment CouponItems on Coupon {
  total
  promotions {
    conditionType
    image {
      url
      __typename
    }
    title
    description
    type
    couponUseType
    couponLandingUrl
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment OptionsForMap on OptionsForMap {
  maxZoom
  minZoom
  includeMyLocation
  maxIncludePoiCount
  center
  spotId
  keepMapBounds
  __typename
}

fragment ReverseGeocodingAddr on ReverseGeocodingResult {
  rcode
  region
  __typename
}

fragment FiltersInfo on PlaceListFiltersInfo {
  filters {
    key
    displayName
    clickCode
    nlogCode
    nlogAreaCode
    items {
      apolloCacheId
      id
      name
      value
      clickCode
      nlogCode
      nlogAreaCode
      count
      iconUrl
      disabled
      sub {
        id
        name
        value
        clickCode
        nlogCode
        nlogAreaCode
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    selectedValue
    separator
    unselectValue
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment HouseBanners on HouseBanner {
  id
  slotIndex
  imageUrl
  linkUrl
  bgColor
  altText
  __typename
}
